_comment_zh: 把 gallery_root 改成你的姿态库根目录（含 data/、thumbs/、img/ 的那一层）。留空则自动探测插件目录 ./、../、../ai-pose-gallery-clone、../../ai-pose-gallery-clone，或读环境变量 POSE_GALLERY_ROOT。
_comment_en: Set gallery_root to your pose library root (the folder containing data/, thumbs/, img/). Leave empty to auto-detect ./ .. ../ai-pose-gallery-clone ../../ai-pose-gallery-clone under the plugin dir, or set the POSE_GALLERY_ROOT env var.
_note: This repo ships NO asset data. You must provide the library yourself and follow its license.
